plans.note: Separate caps for each side (9.1 IBM / 9.2 Customer) — check that IBM's cap is not lower than ours and that carve-outs (indemnity, confidentiality, data breach, fees owed) are mutual; 5.4 may add consequential-damages disclaimers.

8.1 is IBM's indemnity (confirm IP infringement plus its own misconduct, defence and settlement control); 8.2 is our indemnity — keep narrow; sec-1 appears to be the notice/cooperation procedure conditions.
No non-compete heading; 14.16 Freedom of Action is typically vendor-favourable rather than a restraint on us, but scan 14.11 No Resale for indirect limits on our business lines.
No exclusivity clause evident; verify 14.16 and the services/charges provisions do not require us to source hosting solely from IBM.
No MFN language apparent; if any pricing-comparison undertaking sits in 4.1 Charges, confirm it runs in our favour only.
14.8 Personnel is the likely home for any hiring/solicitation restriction — check it is mutual, time-limited (12 months) and carves out general advertising.

3.4 governs convenience termination — confirm we have a reasonable notice right without termination charges and that IBM has no symmetrical mid-term walk-away; cross-check 3.3 cause triggers and 3.5 consequences.
3.2 Renewal — test for automatic extension, length of non-renewal notice window (target 30 days) and any uplift on renewal pricing in 4.1.
14.3 Choice of Law for the accepted-jurisdiction test and any venue/forum wording; 14.4 jury waiver and 14.14 Actions Period are related limitation-of-remedy items.
14.10 Assignment — confirm we may assign to affiliates and to a successor by merger without consent, and that our change of control is not an IBM termination trigger (cross-check 3.3).

12.1 License and 14.17 Limitation of Licenses define ownership boundaries; 11.6 Content and 14.18 Data Protection should confirm our Content/Customer Data remains ours, with return on termination under 3.5.
12.1 is the grant — check scope extends to affiliates and contractors using the services on our behalf and that it is not revocable at will; 14.17 and 14.11 may cut back the scope.
11.3 Suspected Violations is the likely inspection/investigation right (tie to 13.2 AUP) — seek notice, frequency limits, off-site review and IBM bearing its own cost.
No liquidated damages heading; check 4.2 for interest/late-fee penalties and 3.5 for termination charges payable by us.
5.1 is IBM's warranty set with 5.2/5.4 disclaimers to narrow; 11.1 Services Support and 12.2 Maintenance carry the performance/remedy substance — press for a real repair-or-refund remedy.
No insurance section in the outline; propose insertion in Article 14 and cross-reference 5.3 Security and 14.12 Risk of Loss given IBM hosts our data.
Check 4.1 Charges (and Order Form references) for committed volumes or minimum monthly charges and 11.5 Capacity Planning for forced capacity purchases; pair any commitment with our 3.4 exit right.
3.5 Effect of Termination is the natural home — confirm return/export of Customer Data in a usable format, a defined wind-down assistance period, and survival of those duties under 14.2.
